title: Cash Pickup Service Terms: Cancellation by the Customer and Fee Refunds
content:
**Cancellation clauses for Cash Pickup transfers.**

**C1. Who cancels.** Only the customer can cancel their own Cash Pickup transfer. The agent explains what will be refunded, and the customer confirms.

**C2. When a transfer can be cancelled.** A transfer can be cancelled in any of these states:
- awaiting funds;
- on hold;
- ready for pickup, on a tier that allows cancellation while ready for pickup.

Once the cash is collected, the transfer can never be cancelled. An expired transfer is refunded instead of cancelled.

**C3. Full fee refund window.** A fee is refunded in full on cancellation only when the customer confirms the cancellation within the tier's full-refund window. The window is measured in elapsed hours from the moment the transfer was booked to the moment the cancellation was confirmed. A cancellation at exactly the end of the window is inside it.

**C4. Inside the window.** Every fee collected is refunded, recorded as a cancellation within the window.

**C5. After the window.** Each booking fee collected is refunded at the tier's post-window share of its amount, rounded half up to the cent, and recorded as a cancellation after the window. The booking fees are the transfer fee, the card funding fee and the US-dollar payout fee. Name-correction fees and reactivation fees are never refunded on a cancellation after the window.

**C6. Principal.** The principal is always refunded in full under the Cash Pickup refund rules.

**C7. Once only.** Each fee charge is refunded at most once.

## Window boundary (hypothetical booking at 14:00:00 with a 0.50-hour window)

| Cancellation confirmed at | Elapsed | Fee treatment |
|---|---|---|
| 14:29:59 | under 30 minutes | C4, every fee in full |
| 14:30:00 | exactly 30 minutes | C4, every fee in full |
| 14:30:01 | over 30 minutes | C5 |

## After-window illustration (hypothetical 50 percent share)

| Fee collected | Refund |
|---|---|
| transfer fee 3.49 | 50 percent is 1.745, rounded half up to 1.75 |
| card funding fee 9.00 | 4.50 |
| name-correction fee 5.00 | not refunded |
